methods.aggregation: Unrounded per-game arithmetic means; pooled DPM=sum damage/sum minutes; mean KDA uses max(deaths,1), total KDA uses total deaths and null for zero deaths. Shares are percent, differences pp.
methods.efficiency: damage_per_1000_gold is damage/gold*1000; share_efficiency is damage_share/gold_share (dimensionless). 1105.7% damage/gold equals 11057 damage per 1000 gold, NOT 1105.7 damage per 1000.
methods.bootstrap: Joint BO-cluster percentile bootstrap, 3000 draws, seed 20261010; mixed BO sampled once with all players retained; intervals describe associations, not causal effects/posterior probabilities.
methods.BP: Only legal complete original game.raw.bp_list order, crosschecked against step_index/raw_order, ten bans ten picks and final side+hero lineup; raw position/player list is not draft order.
methods.opponents: Exact opponent ID strata, no subjective top-tier grouping.
methods.series_context: Pre-game series score ONLY. Not in-game economic advantage or comeback.
methods.regression: No causal regression: player and stage have minimal overlap; descriptive hero/side sensitivity only.
